sections.title: Cover & Engagement Overview
sections.content:
PROPOSAL: UNIFIED INVENTORY VISIBILITY AND MULTI-WAREHOUSE SYNCHRONISATION PLATFORM
Prepared for: Brightline Retail Group
Key Stakeholders: Marcus Webb (CEO), Jenny Tran (Operations Manager)
Author: Sarah Okafor, Senior Operations Consultant
Date: May 2026
Status: Initial Discovery Draft

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content:
Brightline Retail Group operates three active warehouse facilities across Chicago, Dallas, and Phoenix with 140 staff, serving wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels (from transcript). Rapid growth and impending site expansions into Atlanta and Seattle have exposed critical operational bottlenecks in the 2019 in-house inventory tooling. Daily telephone inquiries between sites and manual spreadsheet compilation (4-5 hours every Monday) have led to painful stock double-allocations (from transcript).

This proposal establishes a unified, real-time inventory visibility platform. Rather than discarding existing infrastructure, our approach builds a high-reliability synchronization layer around Raj's current system, integrates seamlessly with QuickBooks and Shopify, and establishes automated operational reporting to eliminate spreadsheet toil.

sections.title: Proposed Solution & System Architecture
sections.content:
1. Multi-Warehouse Synchronization Engine: A resilient event-driven middleware connecting Chicago, Dallas, and Phoenix into a single live inventory ledger (from transcript). Expands seamlessly to accommodate Atlanta and Seattle without architectural refactoring.

2. Modernized Operations Dashboard: Intuitive, web-based control center tailored specifically for Jenny's warehouse floor operations team, requiring zero developer intervention for daily stock inquiries, allocations, and cross-warehouse rebalancing.

3. Core Integrations:
- QuickBooks Core Accounting: Automated bidirectional sync for financial reconciliation and asset valuation (from transcript).
- Shopify D2C Channel: Real-time stock decrementing handling 20% consumer volume (from transcript).
- Shipping Carrier Software: Architecture accommodates pluggable carrier APIs once carrier selection is finalized (indicative, based on similar engagements — proposal_fleet).

4. Legacy Architecture Preservation: Our engineers will partner with Raj to wrap existing custom endpoints rather than conducting a high-risk 'rip-and-replace' migration (from transcript).

sections.title: Project Timeline & Phased Milestones
sections.content:
Target Launch: End of Q3 (approximately 5 months from commencement) (from transcript).
Operational Fallback Buffer: End of Q4, providing a hardened guarantee ahead of the Atlanta facility opening in Q1 (from transcript).

- Month 1: Discovery, Architecture Blueprint, and Integration Scoping with Raj.
- Month 2: Core Real-Time Synchronization Engine & Warehouse Connectors (Chicago, Dallas, Phoenix).
- Month 3: QuickBooks & Shopify Integration, Automated Operations Reporting Pipeline.
- Month 4: User Acceptance Testing with Warehouse Ops, Parallel Data Reconciliation (indicative, based on similar engagements — proposal_fintech).
- Month 5 (Target Q3 Go-Live): Staged Deployment, Staff Training, and Dashboard Cutover.
- Month 6 (Contingency Buffer Q4): Hardening, Performance Tuning, and Atlanta Expansion Readiness.

sections.title: Budget & Commercial Framework
sections.content:
Commercial structure reflects Marcus's starting target of $50,000 (from transcript) alongside an expanded scope option aligned with the board-approved $120,000 flexibility range (from transcript):

Tier 1: Core Visibility & Sync ($50,000 Target Scope - from transcript)
- Multi-warehouse sync layer (3 sites)
- QuickBooks & Shopify real-time connectors
- Automated Monday ops report generation
- Ops dashboard for inventory allocations

Tier 2: Enterprise Expansion & Scalability Package ($95,000 - $120,000 Indicative - based on similar engagements — proposal_retail2)
- Automated multi-carrier shipping routing when carrier selected
- Native predictive stock rebalancing across regional hubs
- Advanced staff scheduling module (Timeline: not confirmed on the call — to be agreed)

sections.title: Next Steps & Immediate Action Plan
sections.content:
1. Review & Approval: Finalize commercial tier and milestone commitments with Brightline executive team.
2. Technical Scoping Session: Half-day technical review with Raj to audit database schemas and existing API endpoints.
3. Environment Setup: Provision secure sandbox infrastructure and establish read-only connectors.
4. Formal Kickoff: Target kickoff within 10 business days following agreement sign-off.
